title: Skill-lock history and incidents
desc: History and dated incidents for the source-edit skill-lock. Fail-open regression, the lock-count split-signal, deletion-protection, and jisikhwa-on-discovery. Core principle: harness-source-edit-requires-skill-lock.
steps: REGRESSION ROOT 2026-06-07: the lock silently did NOT fire for a long stretch because wkharness-gemini.ps1 was never dot-sourced, so the harness crashed fail-OPEN on every tool call and ALL guards including this one were off. Fixed by adding the dot-source. Cross harness-edit-write-skill-bypass.
